record.reason: This paper probes pre-arrival answer accessibility in a 30M recurrent-depth reasoner and finds measurable hidden-state signals before behavioural competence, while noting the probe population changes with the measure. It studies interpretation/evaluation rather than an inference-efficiency intervention.
record.title: Behaviour Is an Incomplete Measure of Reasoning Development: Cross-surface pre-arrival accessibility and the limits of developmental inference in a recurrent-depth reasoner
